author: Grawe, Lukas
title: Langemarck Myth
publisher: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War (Freie Universität Berlin)
notes: Peer-reviewed encyclopedia article: the text of the OHL communiqué of 11 November 1914, the fighting it actually described (10 November, between Bixschote and Noordschote), the composition of the reserve corps, and the myth's later career.
